title: IRS Tactical Surveillance & ISR Cockpit Update Available
releaseNotes:
• 🛡️ Pure Tactical Surveillance Cockpit: Video-first reconnaissance HUD replacing all agricultural spray controls.
• 🤖 AI Target Bounding Box & Reticle: Real-time classification and tracking.
• 🔍 Dedicated Optical Zoom Ladder: 1x, 2x, 5x, 10x, 20x, 50x, 100x instant selectors.
• 🌡️ Thermal Infrared Palette: 1-tap toggling between Optical RGB, Ironbow, and White-Hot.
• ⚡ Laser Rangefinder (LRF): Ground target GPS coordinates & distance telemetry.
• 🔄 Autonomous Orbit POI: Standoff circular target tracking.
• 💡 Covert Stealth Mode: Blackout navigation lights for silent night ISR operations.
• 🗺️ 1-Tap Map & Video Swap: Instantly switch between live payload and tactical radar.
